Applied Intuition is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to execute high-impact projects and bridge its technology with customers’ operational environments. The role focuses on deploying and integrating products, developing tools for autonomy workflows, and solving engineering challenges in collaboration with customers and internal teams.

Responsibilities
Work directly with customers to deploy and integrate Applied Intuition's products and tools into real-world environments
Work across our entire stack to develop new products, features, and tools for our customers' autonomy development workflows
Tackle a variety of software engineering, infrastructure, robotics, and systems challenges
Have an unparalleled opportunity to work with domain experts across a variety of fields, as well as startup veterans
Take ownership over technical and product decisions and drive projects from development through deployment
Collaborate closely with customers, engineers, and product teams to understand problems and deliver effective solutions
Carve out your own area of expertise and quickly become comfortable with new technical tools and environments

Designed efficient and effective solutions to a wide range of engineering challenges
Strong programming skills, with proficiency in languages such as C++ or Python
Experience taking initiative in a fast-paced environment
Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with customers to solve technical problems
1+ year of experience in any field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Preferred
Working knowledge of frontend, API layer, database ORM, containerization, or cluster orchestration frameworks (such as React, GraphQL, SQLAlchemy, Docker, or Kubernetes)
Experience working with simulation tools, modeling physical problems, or using robotics middleware (such as ROS)
Experience working with complex software systems, infrastructure, robotics, or hardware
Experience in defense, automotive, robotics, or adjacent industries
